scope: Design-only, fail-closed checklist for the future V19 CP4 visible product integration. It binds accepted CP1 geometry/semantics, CP2 shell layout/chrome, and CP3 offscreen atomic preparation. It authorizes no production or CMake edit and makes no GPU, readiness, capture, visual, human-comprehension, product, M3, golden, or beta claim.

required_fields: current CP1 package generation and five digests
current CP2 request layout and exclusion digest
current CP3 preparation generation and identity
explicit_current_frame_request_contract.default_inset_on: Only a newly built explicit request for an accepted TrainingSession or ReplayPlayback state defaults ON. MainMenu, SinglePlayerSetup, Match, TrainingCatalog, ReplayBrowser, Settings, Help, invalid, transitioning, modal, suppressed, errored, or absent requests produce no CP3 call and no inset pixels/tokens/chrome.

session_layout_package_identity_contract.session: Snapshot, accepted screen/state, toggle and shell viewport all share one nonzero sessionSerial and are immutable for the frame.
session_layout_package_identity_contract.layout: CP2 build and audit must succeed from that snapshot. layoutSerial binds profile, physical dimensions, UI scale, exact five exclusions, authoritative panel, transparent plot cutout, border/title/HEAD-FOOT/legend/toggle/focus geometry and CP2 denominator zero.
session_layout_package_identity_contract.package: CP1 package is freshly built from the current trajectory generation, preserves complete world-to-inset parent mapping and the five CP1 digests, and has no camera, scene color, repair coordinate, capture ID, or prior-frame input.
session_layout_package_identity_contract.preparation: CP3 prepared generation, frame serial, sample count, dimensions, CP1 digests, layout digest, palette and current-token ledger equal the current request byte-for-byte.

forbidden_auto_branches: Training or Replay screen enum alone
ordered_visible_sequence: audit CP1 package and CP2 layout/chrome
validate CP3 COMPOSITE_ELIGIBLE generation without publishing stale data
atomically publish the fixed-palette inset into exact CP2 transparent plotCutoutRect
submit CP2 opaque surrounding panel then border title bilingual HEAD-FOOT labels legend toggle and focus after successful publish
restore integration and GL state and seal frame ledgers

visible_atomicity_and_failure_contract.success: Exactly one current CP3 fixed-palette staging image is published into the exact current CP2 cutout, then exactly one audited CP2 chrome list is submitted.
visible_atomicity_and_failure_contract.failure: Any failure before, during, or after the visible publish preflight invalidates the frame. It leaves zero inset pixels, inset semantic tokens, border, title, labels, legend, toggle, or focus from that failed request and never falls back to the world overlay.
visible_atomicity_and_failure_contract.valid_fail_valid: N may publish; N+1 injected failure has zero visible/semantic/chrome residue and destroys its current integration eligibility; N+2 requires fresh session, frame, layout, package and CP3 generations and cannot reuse N or N+1 success flags, textures, mappings, draw lists or ledgers.

required_static_checks: exactly one explicit renderFrame integration call exists only behind a validated request
no automatic screen-only productFrame capture automation camera coordinate or repair-ID enable path
CP1 and CP2 frozen files plus CP3 transaction files remain exact; CP3 accepted behavioral identity is revalidated after the allowlisted adapter extension
world overlay is always OFF and has zero calls/tokens
CMake and files outside a separately authorized allowlist are unchanged
required_gl_mock_checks: 48 positive cases have one prepare one current publish one post-publish audited chrome submit and exact state restore
every integration boundary is injectable and checked in ordered valid-fail-valid
failure frame has zero main/inset pixels tokens and chrome and no stale reuse
current and external GL resources cannot alias and every query/upload/composite/UI transition checks errors
instrumentation-off/on have identical visible color semantic current-token and ordering ledgers
required_negative_fixtures: each nonaccepted screen and absent request
toggle OFF or world overlay ON
modal suppressed invalid errored or transitioning session
zero stale mismatched or reused session frame layout package preparation serial
missing duplicate foreign reordered or relocated exclusion
CP1 digest parent mapping palette denominator or token drift
CP2 cutout panel chrome bilingual order focus or denominator drift
CP3 resource generation sample dimension palette semantic or state drift
publish before CP3 eligibility or chrome before publish
partial visible write chrome-without-plot plot-without-chrome or cutout refill
resize context loss screen change and valid-fail-valid stale resource reuse
GL error or helper throw at every integration transition

ta_axes: plot placement and minimum physical size
actual rails and predicted dash readability
HEAD/开球端 and FOOT/底端 orientation
